html_source: Bloom's home of origin on Clanbrassil Street (red), Pleasants Street (blue), Lombard Street West (purple), St. Kevin's Parade (green), Raymond Street and Raymond Terrace (orange), and Heytesbury Street (black). Arbutus Place, not shown on this map, is in the area crossed by the red arrow, and Ontario Terrace is in the pink box. Source: Hart and Knuth, A Topographical Guide.
